cand.title: Swiss IT Forum(s) 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence of a dated organized programme and a plausible airport-corridor lodging/meeting/catering mechanism, discounted where venue/hotel is committed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two relevant organizer-side contacts are evidenced, but neither is a verified hotel buyer: Yannick Bazin, founder and organizer of Swiss IT Forum(s), is the appropriate senior relationship/routing contact; Sourasith Jayce Rasavady, associate director / projects and technical director, is relevant to operational requirements and identifying the accommodation decision-maker. Their authority to contract room blocks is unverified.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced upcoming edition: Wednesday 29 September–Thursday 30 September 2027. The French and English practical pages identify activity dates, not publication dates. Official homepage: “Save the date : 29 & 30 Septembre 2027”. This falls within the requested horizon. The 2026 edition has already concluded. No 2028 edition was identified in the reviewed official material.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specification: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a conditional satellite-lodging or small ancillary-meeting prospect, not a replacement venue or primary event hotel. A 237-room Founex property with meeting capacity around 250 theatre cannot host this exhibition and its thousands of visitors. Potential demand would need named nonlocal exhibitor, speaker or production teams that are not centrally contracted elsewhere and accept transfers toward La Côte. Airport-corridor relevance is supported by the event access instructions: “The Geneva Airport train station is a few minutes walk away (about 10 min).” This is access guidance, not proof delegates fly or stay overnight. Do not translate visitor counts into rooms. Any initial 20–120-room discussion is a hotel-side qualification range, not event demand. No resort preference or banquet/catering requirement is evidenced; verify catering capacity before proposing meals.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2027 venue: Palexpo Genève, Halle 4 (Porte 3), Parking P12, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte and not downtown Geneva. This is an announced venue commitment, not inspection of a signed contract. Palexpo is an exhibition venue, not a competing host hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified consecutive editions: 20–21 September 2023, 25–26 September 2024, 1–2 October 2025, 30 September–1 October 2026, then announced 29–30 September 2027, all at Palexpo Geneva. Hall 4 is explicit for 2023, 2025, 2026 and 2027; the cited 2024 venue annual report confirms Palexpo but does not specify the hall. This supports annual recurrence in the observed period and venue retention, not destination rotation or an unannounced 2028 date.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown for the 2027 edition. Reviewed official FR/EN event and practical-information pages do not identify a host hotel, hotel list, room block, appointed housing bureau, booking code or hotel RFP; no named incumbent hotels were found. Do not retain the prior “open_or_unannounced” label as evidence of open sourcing. The exhibitor page offers only “the exhibitor file (presentation, formulas, exhibition prices...)”. Palexpo separately advertises a generic reservation service: “Whether you’re stating your requirements or pre-booking a number of rooms, our simple, interactive online booking tool will handle all your requests”. This does NOT establish Swiss IT Forum(s) participation, central contracting or available inventory.
findings.organizationStructure: BY Connect S.A.S. is the official promoter/organizer and legal website owner, a French simplified joint-stock company registered in Annecy, not an association. Its corporate site says it organizes its own B2B events and also provides event coordination/facility-management services and co-production. Swiss IT Forum(s) is a commercial trade exhibition and conference programme. Palexpo is the venue; no separate appointed PCO, DMC or housing operator is evidenced for this edition.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No event-specific overflow, sold-out hotels, housing shortage or committed competing hotel was found. Palexpo has its own generic hotel-reservation channel, but event uptake is unknown. The official afterwork is already programmed in the exhibition area on Wednesday 29 September 2027 from 17:30, with activities at exhibitors’ booths; an offsite replacement networking reception should therefore not be assumed available. Inference: the short walk from Geneva Airport station and onsite networking favour venue-adjacent convenience over an unproven Founex transfer proposition.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Yannick Bazin through the official general-enquiry channel and request the accommodation decision-maker, involving Sourasith Jayce Rasavady for project logistics. Ask whether 2027 accommodation is organizer-managed, handled through Palexpo, agency-managed or booked individually; request every contracted hotel, block size, booking window, cut-off and any permitted supplier-introduction route. Only if uncaptured demand exists, propose a small, staged exhibitor/production-team lodging offer, with transfer feasibility and any ancillary meeting/catering requirements validated before pricing. Do not hold speculative large inventory or pitch relocation of the Palexpo programme. If committed, seek permission for the next hotel procurement cycle.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, access is conditional and unqualified: venue confirmed, accommodation sourcing unconfirmed. Exhibitor-information and general-enquiry channels exist; neither is a hotel RFP. Do not claim lodging is available, centrally contracted, or committed elsewhere. The past 2026 edition is relationship/history evidence only.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference/strategy: develop a repeat relationship with BY Connect and, with permission, named international exhibitor or production teams for satellite lodging or small briefings. Historical retention of Palexpo makes hotel services more plausible than capturing the main conference venue. First establish housing ownership and current supplier terms; if 2027 is closed, ask when the next procurement cycle begins. Do not label 2028 confirmed or assume annual hotel contracts are contestable.
